prompt:

Visual style: futuristic fintech with dark gradients, glowing data cards, AI orb visual placeholder, bento grid feature sections, and premium SaaS polish.
Strong hook: “An AI Funding Strategist for Entrepreneurs Who Hate Banker Theater.”
Hero message: “Get instant guidance on funding options, readiness gaps, documents needed, and next steps before you apply.”
CTA: “Try the AI Funding Strategist”
Sections needed:
- Hero section
- AI assistant preview
- Feature cards
- Use cases
- Sample questions users can ask
- Funding readiness workflow
- Human strategist handoff CTA
- Pricing or free access section
- FAQ
- Final CTA
Generate static files.
